Security updates for gosu, Twisted, setuptools and pip, and Debian updates that reach the published image every week.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Fresh building blocks.** just-containers/s6-overlay 3.2.3.2, x/sys 0.50.0, authlib 1.9.10, soupsieve 4.1.3, twisted 26.10.0, setuptools 84.2.1 and pip 26.3.
- **gosu is built from source with Go 1.27.4.** The gosu in Synapse's image and the upstream release are both built with Go 1.24, which has open security advisories, and with an old x/sys. The image builds its own and puts it at `/usr/sbin/gosu`, where Synapse's start script looks for it.
- **Twisted 26.10.0, setuptools 84.2.1 and pip 26.3.** Synapse's image brings older versions with open security advisories, which this image replaces with the fixed releases.
- **Debian updates never come from the build cache.** The package upgrade runs fresh on every build, so a cached layer cannot bring back the packages of an older build.
- **The published image gets Debian updates every week.** Every Monday the pending Debian updates go on top of `latest`. When no package changed, nothing is pushed, so there is no update to pull.
